## Example and revision

Link the demonstration PR or name the branch and commit. Include the Actions run URL if relevant.

## Expected and observed result

The passing example should return PASS. The drifting example intentionally passes behavior tests while its contract check fails with DRIFT. Explain how your result differs, or what was unclear.

## Reproduction

Include the command, Node/pnpm versions, operating system, and sanitized output. Do not attach private code or credentials.
